scope: All 16 package-owned files at exact upstream pin statically read, including sound-design SKILL.md, 3 references, cues schema, 5 CLI script entrypoints and shared lib_audio helpers. Reviewed script output/destruction paths. No tests, imports, code execution, downloads, model judging, audio reads or edits.

rubric_rationale.trigger_precision: Defined triggers for audio, SFX, voice/music mixing and loudness; clarifies video handoff.
rubric_rationale.procedural_clarity: Clear sequence from source selection to analysis, transient-aligned SFX, blind splice comparison and measured final master; commands named.
rubric_rationale.authority_safety: The blind-splice CLI deletes an arbitrary preexisting --out-dir; other scripts overwrite output paths and no action-specific consent/preflight protects user files.
rubric_rationale.failure_handling: Numeric performance checks and nonzero exit codes exist, but there is no safe recovery from deleted blind-test folders, overwritten stems or missing dependencies.
rubric_rationale.evidence_discipline: Loudness, true peak, transient timing, fades and SFX audibility are tied to computed measurements, though not executed here.
rubric_rationale.dependency_coherence: Package owns all 16 files; uv can resolve Python dependencies and ffmpeg is external. External video-director media_judge sibling is referenced for some review steps.
rubric_rationale.portability_honesty: Requires Python 3.11+, uv, ffmpeg and large scientific Python dependencies; root path assumes Claude install and video-director/OpenRouter is not generally portable.
rubric_rationale.usefulness_differentiation: Measured, reproducible audio timing and blind control comparisons go beyond shallow prompting.
rubric_rationale.adversarial_resilience: No safeguards against unsafe chosen --out-dir or overwriting existing output, and untrusted cue paths are not tied to a project-root allowed-write plan.
rubric_rationale.effectiveness_design: Mechanisms are plausible and measurable but real mix accuracy and preservation of existing files were not tested.

consumer_value: Measure edits rather than guessing: compare musical splices against blind untouched controls, align SFX by transient peak, and verify mastered loudness on the actual output.

critical_findings.observation: When --out-dir already exists, shutil.rmtree(arguments.out_dir) recursively deletes it without any project containment, empty-directory, manifest ownership, dry-run or permission check.
critical_findings.impact: Could erase unrelated user files selected by --out-dir or present in default out/review/splice-blind.
critical_findings.evidence: source text inspected at pinned blob ff577ff8fd3b0c037f5667e411891037abbf0b54

critical_findings.observation: soundfile.write and joins_path.write_text replace chosen --out and sidecar content; no no-clobber mechanism.
critical_findings.impact: Existing WAV or joins JSON can be overwritten.

critical_findings.observation: Writes fixed stem names then mastered output and optional report, with no explicit exists/overwrite gate.
critical_findings.impact: May overwrite prior stems, master audio, and report in the chosen destination.

critical_findings.observation: Reports keyed only by input path stem in a shared report_dir.
critical_findings.impact: Two different source paths with the same stem can overwrite each other's report.

critical_findings.observation: Writes predictable generated SFX filenames and manifest to --out without a no-clobber gate.
critical_findings.impact: Prior user SFX content at same path can be overwritten.

missing_qualification: Safe output plan and confined scratch workdir; no path deletion or overwrite absent explicit action-scoped user approval.
No implicit uv dependency installation, external judgment API use or OpenRouter disclosure without approval.
Rights check for source music, SFX, sample uploads and generated/remixed recordings; root MIT does not license users' audio.
Security scanner on exact tree and executed adversarial/read-write tests; neither ran.
Representative audio file acceptance for tempo, splice confidence, audibility, loudness and true-peak correctness, with real listening review.
